C-SUBSTANTIATION-HONESTY.Summary: Close F9.10, F31, and F32 on the attempt-pair review surface: replace the production-must-move rule with an identical-tree rule that raises only when a fail→pass pair has no non-`.ngrace/` WriteEvidence content change; rename the finding to match the new premise; keep skill prose and CLI enforcement in agreement on both skill trees; always report whether the audit ran; anchor findings at a path that exists for archived bundles.
C-SUBSTANTIATION-HONESTY.Problem:
Three verified findings on one surface (decisions.md F9.10, F31, F32): the fail→pass WriteEvidence audit in `src/review/core.ts` (`auditAttemptPairWriteEvidence` / `runReview`), plus the agent-facing sentence in `ngrace-execute` that still names the rule this bundle repeals.
**F9.10 — the rule has never once fired on a real defect.** Change-scoped review over all 26 archived `C-*` bundles raises `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated` on 6 bundles (8 findings). Every finding was classified from the ledger's own `WriteEvidence` digests, not from the finding's parenthetical (which collapses skills-deliverable and test-strengthening into the same "N non-test src/ path(s) seen, all identical" string — a wrong taxonomy). In all eight pairs something non-production moved (tests, skills, or roadmap prose), and in all eight production *should not* have moved. `C-LEGIBLE-FAILURE` T-002 is the sharpest: production digest `af58dfca…` is byte-identical across the pair because the defect was a weak assertion — the code was already right. Production moving would have been the bug.
The rule's premise — *the deliverable is production code under non-test `src/`* — is false for at least three legitimate task classes: documentation/skills, test strengthening, and roadmap prose. Test paths are excluded from the substantiating set *by design* (F9.3), so a weak-assertion task can never substantiate its own pair no matter how honestly it is executed. A warning with a 100% false-positive rate over its entire operating history is not a check; it is a budget on the reviewer's attention with nothing purchased (F9.9's predicted harm, now measured). Wording-only repair (F9.9's old disposition) is not enough: politer noise is still noise.
**What the evidence does and does not support.** Over the same corpus (26 archived bundles, 35 fail→pass pairs):
| rule | fires | true positives | | production-must-move (today) | 8 | 0 | | identical-tree (proposed) | 0 | 0 |
**Neither rule has ever caught a real defect.** The case for the change is that production-must-move costs a reviewer's attention on every documentation and test-strengthening task, and identical-tree costs nothing until something is actually wrong (a fail→pass pair whose non-`.ngrace/` trees are identical). That is a good argument about attention cost and false-positive rate. It is **not** evidence of detection power, and this spec does not claim the new rule has proven it can catch a live fabrication. Residual both rules share: a staged retrospective red (`git stash` → record fail → unstash → record pass) produces differing trees and defeats both; no rule in this bundle addresses it.
**Skill prose still ships the repealed rule.** Measured (not assumed) at both trees, line 67 of the `attempt` kind entry:
``` skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md ```
Failure shape: `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated` on fail→pass pairs with **no non-test digest movement.** Both the code name and the condition are exactly what this bundle repeals. Renaming the catalog code while that sentence stands recreates F21 on the surface handed to every executor. This is a product change: canonical and packaged skills move together.
**F31 — unscoped review skips the audit in silence.** The audit runs only inside `if (options.changeId)` (`review/core.ts`). `ngrace review --path .` with no `--change` produces Findings: 0 and says nothing about attempt-pair. That is indistinguishable from "the audit ran and found nothing." In the same track, the scope audit prints `Scope audit: not-run — …` with a full `status: "ran" | "not-run" | "unable-to-determine"` vocabulary and reason. Two audits, one report family, one honest about not having looked. The authority recorded a clean close for `C-ESCALATION-HONESTY` from an unscoped review that could not have raised this class at all — the verdict stood on merits (the finding is a false positive) but claimed more scrutiny than it received.
**F32 — findings point at a path that does not exist.** Every finding anchors at the hardcoded string `.ngrace/changes/active/${changeId}/run`. For an archived bundle that path is gone. All six raising bundles are archived, so all eight findings name a missing path. `resolveChangeBundle` already resolves active or archive; the finding builder does not call it.

Goals.Goal: Replace the production-must-move rule with an **identical-tree** rule: for each fail→pass attempt pair on the same task, raise a warning when the union of content digests in WriteEvidence on the fail event and the pass event shows **no path whose content digest differs**, after **excluding every path under `.ngrace/`** (and the `.ngrace` root if present). A path present on only one side of the pair is a difference (add or remove). Undetermined / non-content evidence is not comparable and does not count as a difference by itself (same content-only comparison surface the current helper uses).

**Why exclude `.ngrace/`:** the cursor writes `run.xml` and loose event files on every attempt, so those paths differ across almost any honest pair and would prove nothing if admitted as substantiation or as "something moved." They must be excluded explicitly; the exclusion is part of the rule, not plan-time polish.

Rename the finding code. The new premise is not "production unsubstantiated"; keeping `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated` would leave a code whose title and historical meaning describe a rejected rule. New code: **`review.attempt-pair-identical-tree`**. Remove the old code from `REVIEW_CATALOG` and from every test pin that names it (rewrite, do not leave dual-registration).

**Skill prose matches enforcement on both trees.** In `skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md` and `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md`, surgically replace only the failure-shape clause on the F9.8 ordering line (today line 67) so it names `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` and the identical-tree condition (no non-`.ngrace/` content change across the pair) — not the retired code or "no non-test digest movement." The rest of that line stays: WriteEvidence digests ObservedWriteScope at attempt command time; red in its own round trip; never stage a retrospective red. Canonical and packaged remain byte-identical after the edit (`scripts/validate-marketplace.ts` / `git diff --no-index`).

**Absence record (F31):** whenever process audits run, the review result always carries an attempt-pair audit status on the same vocabulary as scope audit (`ran` | `not-run` | `unable-to-determine`) with a reason. Unscoped `ngrace review --path .` (no `--change`) reports `not-run` with reason that no `--change` was supplied — never silent omission. Text report and JSON both surface it. A report must not read as a clean full audit when attempt-pair was `not-run` (same honesty bar as the scope-audit "No review findings" caveat).

**Anchor path (F32):** finding `file` is a path that exists for the resolved bundle — active or archive — via `resolveChangeBundle` (or equivalent), not a hardcoded `active/` string. Prefer the bundle's `run/` directory when present; otherwise the bundle directory or `run-ledger.xml` under the resolved location. A reviewer following the path reaches the ledger that produced the digests.

**Archive corpus pin (exact):** under the new rule, change-scoped review over all **26** archived `C-*` bundles yields **exactly 0** findings with code `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` (and 0 with the retired code). Justified case-by-case for the eight pairs that fire today (each has at least one non-`.ngrace/` content difference — measured below in Assumptions). Not asserted as "zero-ish" or "fewer than today." Corpus zero alone is satisfied by a detector broken into permanent silence; positive fixtures (AC-FIXTURES-REWRITTEN) are the counterweight.

Existing unit fixtures that encode the *old* goldens (test-only raises, production-identical-with-test-movement raises, live archive pairs that currently raise) are **rewritten to the new rule** — not preserved as correctness pins of the defect (F21 class: suite must not pin the bug). New fixtures pin: pure identical non-`.ngrace/` trees raise; any single non-`.ngrace/` content change silences; `.ngrace/`-only changes still raise.

Constraints.Constraint: Binding: decisions.md F9.10, F31, F32 (subject); F9.3 / F9.9 (rule history and deliberate non-widening of `isSubstantiatingPath` to `skills/`); F9.5 (concurrent-work ceiling — unchanged: digests cannot attribute movement); F9.1 (no staged retrospective red as a repair); F12 / F21 (contract describes protocol — skill prose and CLI must agree on the live finding code and condition); F23 (exact pins — finding code string, corpus count 0, absence status strings); F26 / F30 (criteria must be satisfiable at the moment they claim); F27 (declare write scope; do not hope a pin is untouched); F29 (token-accounting pin is a line count); D5.5 (CHANGELOG.md generated — never hand-edited); F4 (two-stage: this authoring pass is **spec only**, `status="draft"`; do not author `plan.xml` until the spec is approved).

**The rule is decided in this spec, not deferred to the plan.** The plan may choose function names, report field names, and test layout, but must not re-open: identical-tree vs production-must-move vs per-task deliverable declaration; the `.ngrace/` exclusion; the new finding code string; the corpus expectation of exactly 0 over 26 archived bundles; whether unscoped review must declare absence; or whether both skill trees must name the live code and not the retired one.

Ceremony tier **T2 (cross-cutting)** — consequence of skill trees entering scope alongside the review rename, not a separate judgement. Full sections; multi-module AffectedAreas (`M-REVIEW`, `M-SKILLS`, `M-TEST-SUPPORT`); integration evidence in VerificationIntent (CLI matrix + skill prose presence/absence + marketplace mirror parity).

AffectedAreas is a closed list and binds the plan (`change.plan-scope-exceeds-spec`). A plan that needs a module not named here is a stop-and-report. Over-declaring grants unreviewed scope; under-declaring costs a re-spec.

Both skill trees always: edit canonical `skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md` and keep `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md` synchronized in the same change. `scripts/validate-marketplace.ts` requires packaged-vs-canonical parity via `git diff --no-index`. The edit is **surgical**: only the failure-shape clause of the F9.8 ordering line; do not rewrite the surrounding red-first discipline sentence.

Deliberately **not** adopted: widening `isSubstantiatingPath` (or any successor) to include `skills/`, `docs/`, or other non-`src/` trees. F9.9's argument stands and F9.10's measurement does not disturb it: a documentation change moving a documentation file does not make a production-red claim honest, and under the new rule documentation movement is simply "something non-`.ngrace/` moved," which correctly silences the *fabrication* detector without pretending production moved. (Editing skill *prose about the finding* is in scope; treating skill path movement as production substantiation under the old rule is not.)

Classify archive pairs and any future adjudication from **WriteEvidence digests**, never from the finding message parenthetical alone (F9.10 caution). Tests that seed corpus shapes must set digests explicitly.

This bundle does **not** touch product version surfaces: not `package.json` version, README packaged-version marker, `openpackage.yml`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, or `plugins/ngrace/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`. Version surfaces belong to `release:bump`. CHANGELOG.md remains unedited (D5.5). No edits under `.ngrace/changes/archive/` or `docs/plans/archive/`. decisions.md is not amended by this bundle — F9.10 / F31 / F32 remain the authority's record; this bundle cites and closes them.

Evidence doctrine: red-first regressions for each AC. Pins are exact (F23): code string `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree`, corpus count **0**, absence status **`not-run`** with a reason naming missing `--change`, anchor path under the resolved bundle (active *or* archive), skill files contain the live code and not the retired code. Deliberate mutation tests: re-introducing production-only filtering must fail; dropping `.ngrace/` exclusion must fail; skill still naming the retired code or the old condition must fail; skill and code able to drift the code string independently must fail.

Reuse existing scoring machinery where it fits (`src/test-support/defect-corpus.ts`, `bun run validate:ci` / determinism gate). Prefer extending those over a parallel one-off scorer. Archive re-score may be a focused test or script invoked from the suite; it must pin **exactly 0**, not a softer bound.

Anticipated write scope (plan OWS must not exceed without re-spec): `src/review/core.ts`, `src/review/catalog.ts`, `src/review/core.test.ts`, `skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md`, `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md`, `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` (declared always — pin is a line count (F29); in-place sentence replacement will very likely leave totals at 779, but "very likely" is not a declaration (F27); if the pin does not move, the plan says so after re-measure), and as forced by catalog/code pins: `src/lint/catalog.test.ts`, `src/verification/localize.test.ts`, optionally `src/test-support/defect-corpus.ts` / scorer tests if corpus seeds gain an identical-tree entry.

NonGoals.NonGoal: **Rejected option — keep production-must-move and reword the message (F9.9 disposition).** Politer false positives remain false positives. F9.10 supersedes wording-only repair.

**Rejected option — drop the finding entirely.** Pure fabrication (fail→pass with nothing non-`.ngrace/` changed) is still a real dishonesty shape the ledger can detect. Zero archive hits today is not evidence the shape cannot occur; it is evidence the old premise only found noise. Keeping a silent-until-wrong detector is preferred to deleting the surface.

**Rejected option — per-task deliverable declaration in plan grammar** (production | test | documentation) with a rule that consults it. F9.10's disposition leaned this way; this bundle does not.
**Deciding defect (incentive):** the declaration would be authored by the **same agent whose honesty the check is testing.** That is the identical objection that produced trigger D in `C-ESCALATION-HONESTY` — FailureSignature keys are agent-authored, so an executor that cannot characterise its failure invents a new key each time, leaving the repeat rule blindest exactly where the checkpoint matters most. A deliverable class field has the same structure: under pressure to clear a red, the agent that would fabricate a fail can also label the task "test" or "documentation" and walk past a production-must-move check. A detector that trusts the subject for its premise is not a detector.
Surface size (plan-grammar / schema across every future plan) is a real **cost**, not the defect. If a later bundle revisits deliverable class, the cost argument will look weak and the incentive argument will still be correct — record the incentive as the reason this option is rejected.
Secondary (not deciding): shapes beyond identical-tree that declaration might catch have never been verified true positives in the 26-bundle corpus; F9.3 already established digests cannot read intent. Those do not license ignoring the incentive defect.

**Rejected option — widen substantiating paths to `skills/` (or docs).** Explicitly out of scope per F9.9 / F9.10 and Constraints. Distinct from editing skill *prose about the finding*, which is in scope.

Catching **staged retrospective reds** (`git stash` → record fail → unstash → record pass). Trees differ; neither the current rule nor identical-tree fires. Honest residual: that shape needs evidence outside pairwise WriteEvidence (e.g. verification identity, or fail-time proof that the failing command ran against the tree claimed). No third rule is forced into this bundle; naming the residual is the contribution.

Changing gate policy, fold ordering, fix-budget / escalation (`C-ESCALATION-HONESTY`), flake classification in `grace-cursor` (including its own "identical write evidence" flaky reason, which today does **not** exclude `.ngrace/` and is out of band for this review finding), or claimedConfidence semantics.
New event kinds, WriteEvidence schema redesign, or per-task ObservedWriteScope (F9.5's stronger attribution property). Bundle-wide OWS remains.

Broader skill rewrites beyond the surgical failure-shape clause on the F9.8 ordering line in ngrace-execute. Other skills, README CLI tables, or marketplace copy not required for prose/enforcement agreement.
Any product version bump or hand-edit of CHANGELOG.md. Other open findings not F9.10 / F31 / F32. Amending decisions.md (authority-owned).

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-IDENTICAL-TREE-RULE: For a fail→pass pair, `auditAttemptPairWriteEvidence` (or its successor) raises **exactly when** no non-`.ngrace/` content path differs across the pair's WriteEvidence digests. **Must raise:** both sides empty of non-`.ngrace/` content paths; both sides identical non-`.ngrace/` digests; only `.ngrace/**` paths differ. **Must not raise:** any single non-`.ngrace/` content digest change; path present on only one side outside `.ngrace/`; test-only movement; skills-only movement; production movement. Production-must-move / `isSubstantiatingPath` filtering is gone as the raise condition (helpers may be deleted or left unused — plan mechanism). **Values named:** raise boolean per shape above; exclusion prefix `.ngrace/`. **Failure conditions:** test-only pair still raises; skills-only pair still raises; `.ngrace/`-only difference silences; pure identical non-`.ngrace/` pair is silent; production-only filter reintroduced as the gate.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-FINDING-CODE-RENAME: Catalog and emitters use code **`review.attempt-pair-identical-tree`** exactly (F23). Title/explanation describe identical non-`.ngrace/` WriteEvidence trees / fabricated or empty red-first sequence — not "no non-test src/ production movement." Code `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated` is **absent** from `REVIEW_CATALOG`, `allReviewCodes()`, and suite assertions. Severity remains **warning**. Guide remediation still points at gate verdict `--note` keyed by findingId for adjudication when needed. **Failure conditions:** old code still registered; dual codes both fire; severity elevated to error without spec change; explanation still claims production-file corroboration as the rule.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PROSE-ENFORCEMENT-AGREE: Both `skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md` and `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md` state the live finding code **`review.attempt-pair-identical-tree`** and the identical-tree condition (no non-`.ngrace/` content-digest movement / equivalent plain language bound to that rule) in the failure-shape clause of the F9.8 ordering line. Neither file contains `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated` or the retired condition phrase **no non-test digest movement** as the attempt-pair failure shape. **How checked:** tests that (a) drive the identical-tree matrix against the CLI and (b) fail if either skill tree omits the live code, still names the retired code, still states the old condition, or if skill and catalog can mutate the code string independently without a test failing. Positive presence **and** negative absence on **both** paths — a kind-set completeness check alone does not satisfy this AC (F21 / C-EXECUTION-CONTRACT trap). **Failure conditions:** only canonical updated; packaged still names the old code; skill says new code but old condition; only one of presence/absence asserted; only one tree checked.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SKILL-MIRROR-IDENTICAL: After the change, `skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md` and `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md` are byte-identical (`git diff --no-index` clean / validate-marketplace packaged-vs-canonical check green). **Failure conditions:** only canonical edited; drift left for a later cleanup; eye-check claimed without validator.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ARCHIVE-CORPUS-ZERO: Against repository archives at the change's close tree: for each of the **26** directories `.ngrace/changes/archive/C-*`, `ngrace review --path . --change <C-ID>` yields **exactly 0** findings whose code is `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` (and 0 whose code is the retired `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated`). Aggregate finding count for those codes over the 26 bundles is **0**. Checked by suite or script that enumerates the same 26 dirs (not a hand-waved sample). Case-level justification for the eight historical false positives is recorded in Assumptions and need not be re-derived in the test, but the test must fail if any archive pair starts raising. **Relationship to AC-FIXTURES-REWRITTEN:** corpus zero alone is satisfied by a rule that never fires at all, including one broken into silence; the positive identical-tree fixtures are what separate a correct zero from a dead detector. Both criteria are required. **Failure conditions:** count asserted as ">0 cleared" or "fewer than 8"; only the six formerly-raising bundles scanned; retired code still counted as success when present; soft `toBeLessThan`; corpus zero treated as sufficient without positive raise fixtures.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ABSENCE-RECORD: When process audits are enabled and `--change` is **omitted**, the review result includes attempt-pair audit **`status: "not-run"`** with a reason that states no `--change` was supplied (exact phrasing plan-owned; must be machine-checkable and human-visible in text report, e.g. a line `Attempt-pair audit: not-run — …`). When `--change` is supplied and the bundle resolves, status is **`ran`** (including when zero pairs exist — ran and found none is not silent skip). JSON and text both expose the status. Unscoped Findings: 0 must not be readable as "attempt-pair audited clean" — either the absence line is always printed when process audits ran, or the clean epilogue is suppressed when attempt-pair is `not-run` (same honesty idea as scope audit's "No review findings" caveat). **Failure conditions:** unscoped report omits attempt-pair entirely; status missing from JSON; `--change` present but status still `not-run` without reason; zero-pair change reported as `not-run`.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ANCHOR-RESOLVED-BUNDLE: Every `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` finding's `file` path is under the bundle location returned by `resolveChangeBundle` (active **or** archive). For each of the six historically raising archive ids, a synthetic or live raise (if forced by fixture) must not use `.ngrace/changes/active/<id>/…` when the bundle exists only under `archive/`. Pin: for `C-ESCALATION-HONESTY` (archived), anchor starts with `.ngrace/changes/archive/C-ESCALATION-HONESTY` (or equals that bundle's resolved run/ledger path) — not `…/active/C-ESCALATION-HONESTY/…`. **Failure conditions:** hardcoded `active/` string remains; archive review still points at missing path; only message fixed, not `file`.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-FIXTURES-REWRITTEN: Suite no longer expects raises on: test-only movement; production identical + test movement (old F9 / T-002 pure shape); live `C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY` T-001 / T-005 or `C-CURSOR-INTEGRITY` T-007 under the new code. Suite **does** expect raise on pure identical non-`.ngrace/` digests and on `.ngrace/`-only differences — these positive fixtures are the counterweight to AC-ARCHIVE-CORPUS-ZERO (corpus silence without a forced raise is insufficient). Live archive read-only tests that previously expected unsubstantiated findings are updated to expect **0** for both old and new codes on those pairs. **Failure conditions:** old goldens left green-by-coincidence; live archive still asserts raise for T-005 test-only; no positive fixture for identical-tree raise; corpus zero alone treated as proof the detector works.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SUITE-AND-LINT: Red-first regressions cover each AC above with exact assertions (F23). `bun test` green for touched packages; `bun run validate:ci` green; `bun run ./scripts/validate-marketplace.ts` green (mirror identical; version surfaces untouched); `bun run ngrace lint --path .` is 0 errors and 0 warnings **at close** (after apply/archive of this change — not claimed for mid-change dirty trees); unscoped review after close prints the attempt-pair absence record when process audits ran. No edits under `docs/plans/archive/` or `.ngrace/changes/archive/`; no CHANGELOG.md; no version / marketplace / openpackage version surface edits; decisions.md untouched by this bundle. If review catalog cardinality pins exist (localize / catalog tests), they are updated for rename-not-add as measured — partition invariants preserved, not weakened. `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` is re-measured after the skill edit (F29): if the total line pin moves, update it to the new exact total; if it does not move, leave the pin and record that in the plan — either way the file was in declared scope (F27). **Failure conditions:** suite red; lint dirty by design silence; archive or decisions.md edits; version surfaces hand-bumped; cardinality pin left asserting the retired code string; skill line total moved while pin left at pre-change total; token-accounting left undeclared in plan OWS.

Assumptions.Assumption:
**Recommended rule: identical-tree (exclude `.ngrace/`).** Sharper signature of the dishonesty the check exists to catch: a fail and a pass whose authored trees are the same — a red that never happened. Measured at authoring HEAD against all fail→pass pairs in `.ngrace/changes/archive/*/run-ledger.xml` (path = File element text; content digests only; exclude path prefix `.ngrace/`):
| metric | value | | archived C-* bundles | 26 | | fail→pass pairs | 35 | | pairs with identical non-`.ngrace/` trees | **0** | | current-rule findings (`review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated`) | 8 on 6 bundles |
**Evidence ceiling (do not overclaim):**
| rule | fires | true positives | | production-must-move | 8 | 0 | | identical-tree | 0 | 0 |
Neither rule has a measured true positive. The change is justified by false-positive cost (8→0 on this corpus) and by still raising on pure identical non-`.ngrace/` trees in fixtures — not by a live detection win. Staged retrospective reds defeat both rules (NonGoals).
Commands that reproduced current-rule counts (match F9.10's table exactly):
``` for c in $(ls -1 .ngrace/changes/archive/C-*); do bun run ngrace review --path . --change "$(basename "$c")" done # → 6 bundles raising, 8 findings; rows equal F9.10 table ```

**Skill prose measured (not assumed absent).** Command:
``` rg -n "attempt-pair-unsubstantiated|no non-test digest" \ skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md \ plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md ```
Both files hit line 67 only, same clause: Failure shape `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated` on fail→pass pairs with no non-test digest movement. Trees are currently byte-identical (`cmp -s` clean). Surgical replacement of that clause only; surrounding F9.8 ordering, WriteEvidence timing reason, disclosed-gap cheapness, and ban on staged retrospective reds remain true under the new rule.

**What identical-tree stops catching** (current rule raises; new rule silent), honesty about residual:
1. **Production claim + only tests move** (pure F9 / T-002 synthetic shape; moved goalpost). Never a verified true positive in the live archive corpus (F9.10: 0/8). F9.3: digests cannot separate this from honest test-only deliverables. 2. **Production claim + only docs/skills move.** Same: archive hits were honest skills/docs tasks, not production lies. 3. **Honest gap with production already fixed at fail and only tests moving at pass** (F9.4 T-007 shape).
